title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT DOES NOT SUCCEED IN MAKING ANYBODY LISTEN TO REASON
summary_hover: The train encounters a ruined suspension bridge, and the engineer proposes jumping it at full speed, much to Passepartout's alarm.
summary_detail: As the train continues across the Rocky Mountains, Aouda spots Colonel Proctor on board, and the group distracts Fogg with whist to prevent a duel. The journey is halted by a severely damaged suspension bridge over Medicine Bow rapids. Instead of the passengers crossing safely on foot first—as Passepartout vainly attempts to suggest—the engineer successfully drives the entire train across at maximum speed just as the bridge collapses behind them.
